title: lepton.config.json
description: A Lepton project's configuration. Every rule here is one the lepton CLI enforces when it reads the file.

productName.description: The application's name. The binary is named after it. No control characters, no / or \, not . or ..

identifier.description: Reverse-DNS identifier: the desktop entry, the window's app id and the per-application data directory. ASCII letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'; not . or ..

version.description: Letters, digits, '.', '+', '~' and '-'; it is part of package file names.

renderPath.description: webview: the page in WPE WebKit (Linux) or WebView2 (Windows). native: the core draws the window, no web engine.

target.description: The frontend framework the project was created with.

sdkScope.description: The npm scope this project's Lepton packages come from: lepton update moves the dependencies under it, and lepton dev rebuilds the linked ones. A mirror or fork that publishes Lepton as @acme/api names "@acme".

name.description: The shared-memory channel: starts with / and has no other /.

decorations.description: false: no system title bar; the page draws its own and moves the window with window.start_drag (Windows). Default true.

contextMenu.description: The default right-click menu where the page does not take the click: Cut, Copy, Paste, Select All (Inspect in a developer's build). Default true; false shows none. A page's own contextmenu handler with preventDefault() always wins.

frameRate.description: How fast a native app draws: "display" (default) at the screen's refresh, "unlimited" as fast as the machine can. LEPTON_FRAME_RATE overrides it when the program runs.

permissions.description: The commands the page may call, each by name: no wildcards. An unlisted command is refused.

webPermissions.description: What the web engine may grant the page. Unlisted kinds are denied; "ask" needs "permission.respond" in permissions.

threads.description: true: WebAssembly threads (SharedArrayBuffer). The page is cross-origin isolated: the core and the dev server send Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin and Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy: require-corp, so a resource from another origin loads only with CORS or Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy. On Linux WPE also turns on JavaScriptCore's SharedArrayBuffer for the app's web process. Default false.

deepLinks.description: URL schemes the application opens ("myapp" for myapp://…). A link starts the app, or reaches the running copy as the app.opened event (@lepton-desk/api/app); list app.args under permissions to read it.

plugins.description: Settings for plugins that take them, by the section name the plugin declares (fs: { "scope": ["$APPDATA"] }, clipboard: { "read": "always" }).

read.description: When clipboard.read_text answers: "input" (default) only within 5 s of the user pressing a key or button in the window; "always" without one, for a clipboard manager.

targets.description: Release formats, in order. Without it: tar.gz on Linux, zip on Windows. arch and deb are made only on Linux.

depends.description: Debian package names, for a machine without dpkg-query.

icon.description: The app's icon, relative to the project: an .ico for Windows (the program, the installer's shortcut and Apps entry), an .svg for Linux (the desktop entry and packages), or a list with one of each.

frontend.description: How the frontend is built and served. Without it: Vite's dist/ and flags.

dist.description: The bundler's output directory, inside the project (out for Next.js).

devArgs.description: The flags after `<manager> run dev`, with {port} and {host} where the dev server takes them.
